_doc: Acknowledged CALLERS of request_render_audit that write RENDER_AUDIT_TRUNCATED rows without rotating (bugs_open/394; reader: cmd/config-key-audit/rendertruncation.go). A key here says: this agent truncates deliberately, its prefix sample is a reviewed decision, and it is not a coverage debt. An entry with an empty `reason` is ignored and warned about — a hollow ack is not an ack. This file ships inside the check's image from committed HEAD, so an unreviewed acknowledgement is unrepresentable (the commit_sha_exposure_acks.json rule). Do NOT acknowledge a caller to quieten the check: the whole point of the third arm is that a new agent quietly deciding not to cover a site becomes a finding the morning after its first run.

design-critique-agent.reason: OWNER RULING 2026-09-03: 'leave it' — this agent KEEPS ITS PREFIX. Asked explicitly (rotate / curate / leave) on closing bugs_open/394 and ruled: it stays a taste instrument, not a coverage instrument. Reversible by design — rotate_coverage: true on its audit step is a one-line migration. ⚠ THE PRECONDITION BELOW STILL STANDS AND THE RULING DOES NOT COVER IT: if this agent ever gains a cadence, re-open the question, because a SCHEDULED sampler that never revisits IS a coverage debt and that is not what was ruled on. Deliberately NOT opted in to the coverage cursor, and its prefix is the reviewed choice. It is a MANUAL sampler with no cadence — its own seed (sql_for_agents/645_design_critique_agent.sql) states 'NO cadence — manual trigger only, per the recorded owner decision. Nothing emits work for this agent; nothing promotes into it; the only path is a hand dispatch.' So its truncation is not an accruing coverage debt the way a scheduled rotation's is: nothing is silently falling behind between runs. Its cap of 8 (against 25 sites with more than 8 live pages, measured 2026-08-26) selects the nav-ordered prefix, which for a VISION critique is plausibly the intended sample — the 6 nav pages plus the top tools — rather than any 8. Rotating what a design critique looks at would change what the product judges without anyone deciding that, so it is left as an owner question (bugs_open/394 follow-up 2), not taken silently. If this agent ever gains a cadence, this ack expires: re-open the question, because a scheduled sampler that never revisits IS a coverage debt.
